## Setup

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(tidyverse)
library(SeuratObject)
library(scCustomize)
library(MAST)
library(SoupX)

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v3")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "murine-cart-tumor")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# Source function
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "run_doubletfinder.R"))
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "util", "run_soupx.R"))

# set random seed
set.seed(1234)
```

## Load data

```{r load-seurat-object}
obj <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "cart_myeloid_subtypes.rds"))
```

## Subset to CD28-41BB, 41BB-L, and STOP cells separately
```{r subset-grant-cells}
obj_cd28 <- subset(obj, subset = condition %in% c("CD28-41BB"))
obj_41bb <- subset(obj, subset = condition %in% c("41BB-L"))
obj_stop <- subset(obj, subset = condition %in% c("STOP"))
```

## Seurat reprocessing and integration for each subsetted object
```{r seurat-reprocess}
objs <- list(CD28 = obj_cd28, L41BB = obj_41bb, STOP = obj_stop)

reprocess_sample <- function(sub_obj) {
  
  sub_obj[["RNA"]] <- split(sub_obj[["RNA"]], f = sub_obj$sample)

  sub_obj <- NormalizeData(sub_obj)
  sub_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(sub_obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
  sub_obj <- ScaleData(sub_obj)
  sub_obj <- RunPCA(sub_obj)

  sub_obj <- IntegrateLayers(
    object = sub_obj, method = CCAIntegration,
    orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.cca", verbose = FALSE
  )

  sub_obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sub_obj[["RNA"]])
  sub_obj <- RunUMAP(sub_obj, reduction = "integrated.cca", 
                     reduction.name = "umap", reduction.key  = "UMAP_", dims = 1:20)

  sub_obj
}

objs <- lapply(objs, reprocess_sample)
```

## Visualize UMAPs
```{r visualize-umaps, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
DimPlot(objs$CD28, reduction = "umap", group.by = "myeloid_subtype") + ggtitle("CD28-41BB")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "umap_cd28_myeloid_subtypes.png"), width=10, height=6)

DimPlot(objs$L41BB, reduction = "umap", group.by = "myeloid_subtype") + ggtitle("41BB-L")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "umap_41bb_myeloid_subtypes.png"), width=10, height=6)

DimPlot(objs$STOP, reduction = "umap", group.by = "myeloid_subtype") + ggtitle("STOP")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "umap_stop_myeloid_subtypes.png"), width=10, height=6)
```
